## 🕹 MrProphecy Arcade (29 tools)

- [🎲 Backgammon](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool/boardgame-backgammon.html): Classic backgammon: move your pieces around the board and bear them off first. Roll dice and race against the AI!
- [🔴⚫ Checkers / Draughts](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool/boardgame-checkers.html): Classic checkers with mandatory jumps and king promotion. Click a piece then click where to move. Play against the AI.
- [♟️ Chess](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool/boardgame-chess.html): Play chess against a simple AI. Full rules: castling, en passant, pawn promotion. Click a piece then click where to move.
- [🔴⚫ Connect Four](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool/boardgame-connect-four.html): Drop discs to connect four in a row — horizontally, vertically, or diagonally. Play against a smart AI with animations.
- [🁣 Dominoes](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool/boardgame-dominoes.html): Block dominoes: match ends to play your tiles. If you can't play, draw from the boneyard. Lowest hand score wins!
- [🎲 Ludo](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool/boardgame-ludo.html): Race your 4 tokens from start to home! Roll a 6 to enter the board. Land on opponents to send them back. 2-4 player local.
- [🪨 Mancala](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool/boardgame-mancala.html): Ancient strategy game — sow seeds around the board, capture your opponent's stones. Free turn if your last seed lands in your store.
- [⚬ Nine Men's Morris](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool/boardgame-nine-mens-morris.html): Place and slide pieces to form mills (3 in a row). A mill lets you remove an opponent's piece. Reduce them to 2 to win!

- [🌤️ Migration & Thermal Lift Calc](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool/bird-migration-weather-calc.html): Predict hawk watches, songbird flyways, and coastal fallouts. Evaluates synoptic frontal boundaries, barometric rise, wind vectors, and solar thermal lift.
- [🪶 Bird Molt Cycle & Ageing Lab](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool/bird-molt-cycle-ageing.html): Avian Humphrey-Parkes (H-P) plumage terminology and molt-limit ageing engine. Decode annual feather replacement cycles between juvenile, alternate, and basic plumages.
- [🪺 Bird Nest Box Dimensions Guide](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool/bird-nest-box-hole-sizing.html): Cornell Lab of Ornithology nest box builder. Exact hole diameters, interior floor dimensions, and predator exclusion clearance for native cavity nesters.
- [🦅 Raptor & Flight Silhouette ID](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool/bird-silhouette-flight-id.html): Identify raptors and aerial birds in high-overhead flight by wing aspect ratio, tail proportions, wingtip finger slots, and characteristic wingbeat cadence.
- [🎶 Bird Song Mnemonic Trainer](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool/bird-song-mnemonic-trainer.html): Acoustic field ornithology trainer. Decode avian vocalizations using phonetic mnemonics, pitch contours, and synthesized frequency playback.
- [🔍 Avian Anatomy & Field Marks](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool/bird-topography-field-marks.html): Standard ornithological avian topography map. Learn precise feather tracts, facial stripes, wing coverts, and bill structures to nail difficult field identifications.
- [🔭 Binocular Optics & FOV Lab](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool/birding-binocular-optics-calc.html): Optical performance evaluator for birdwatchers. Calculates exit pupil, twilight factor, relative brightness, and converts field of view across feet, meters, and angular degrees.
- [📋 Birding Life List & Big Year](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool/birding-life-list-tally.html): Personal field lifer ledger & annual Big Year tally. Records lifetime ticks, date of observation, habitat biome, and exports to CSV for eBird backup.
- [🌸 Hummingbird Nectar & Spoilage](https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tool/hummingbird-nectar-spoilage.html): Formulate natural 20% sucrose syrup and monitor microbial fermentation rates. Calculates exact water-to-cane-sugar ratios and temperature-driven spoilage limits.
